decisions.reason: The multi-layer end-to-end security architecture underpins the firm's other identity and mobile security offers, so it keeps many follow-on options open at little separate cost, even though it was no longer featured on the website.

The email-to-app delivery robot has not been visible since 2018, which suggests weak uptake, so this niche option has largely revealed its low value and its resources are better used in core development.
With PSD2 strong customer authentication now settled largely on app-based solutions, the hardware-cost-heavy QR token's uncertainty has resolved unfavorably, so abandoning the option is justified.

Payment network compliance requirements continue to evolve and fit the firm's regulatory security positioning, so despite low visibility the option still holds plausible value at a modest cost to maintain.
